facts.text: Hydrostatic transmissions brake dynamically: when the swashplate returns toward neutral, the motor acts as a pump and slows the wheels, as described in US patent 12157443.
facts.quote: Hydrostatic transmissions brake dynamically. When the swashplate returns toward neutral, the motor acts as a pump and slows the wheels (US patent 12157443)

facts.text: Some compact loaders formally list hydrostatic dynamic braking as the auxiliary brake; the 2017 Yanmar V10 specification is an example.
facts.quote: some compact loaders list this formally as the auxiliary brake (Yanmar V10 specification, 2017).

facts.text: US patent 12157443 notes that stopping distance increases beyond the dynamic-braking value when the parking brake must act as backup.
facts.quote: The same patent notes that when the parking brake has to act as backup, stopping distance grows beyond the dynamic-braking value.

facts.text: ISO 3450 defines a hydrostatic drive as a hydraulic drive to wheels or tracks that both propels and slows the machine.
facts.quote: ISO 3450 defines a hydrostatic drive as a hydraulic drive to wheels or tracks that both propels and slows the machine

facts.text: ISO 3450 allows the service-brake function to involve the propel control.
facts.quote: allows the service-brake function to involve the propel control

facts.text: ISO 3450 distinguishes hydrostatic slowing from parking-brake capability: continuous "back throttling" is not a substitute for a parking brake.
facts.quote: distinguishes this from parking-brake capability: continuous "back throttling" is not a substitute for a parking brake.

facts.text: Tracked-vehicle hydrostatic studies identify fluid viscosity, system pressure, pump speed and displacement, engine braking torque, and torque and volumetric efficiencies as determinants of hydrostatic braking capacity.
facts.quote: Hydrostatic braking capacity depends on fluid viscosity, system pressure, pump speed and displacement, engine braking torque, and torque and volumetric efficiencies (tracked-vehicle hydrostatic studies).

facts.text: Bosch Rexroth-type patents regulate the hydrostatic motor per axle using dynamic axle-load estimation to prevent wheel lock.
facts.quote: Bosch Rexroth-type patents regulate the hydrostatic motor per axle with dynamic axle-load estimation to prevent wheel lock.

facts.text: The relationship between brake command and deceleration is not one actuator transfer function; it is a state-dependent blend of hydrostatic retarding, driveline effects, friction-brake application, engine or electric retardation, and anti-lock or traction behavior that changes with temperature and operating state.
facts.quote: It is a state-dependent blend of hydrostatic retarding, driveline effects, friction-brake application, engine or electric retardation and anti-lock or traction behavior, which changes with temperature and operating state.

facts.text: A hydrostatic braking model needs pump and motor displacement, pressure limits, engine and pump speed, and controller transitions rather than a pedal-to-torque gain.
facts.quote: A hydrostatic model therefore needs pump and motor displacement, pressure limits, engine and pump speed and controller transitions rather than a pedal-to-torque gain

facts.text: Hydrostatic braking capacity must be modeled as a function rather than a constant.
facts.quote: the braking capacity must be modeled as a function, not a constant.
